notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics platform building an in-app conversational assistant plus search. Initially leaning Hosted API for speed-to-market; showing strong interest in Dedicated once unit economics proven. POC objectives: validate latency <120ms p95 for short chat turns, embeddings throughput ~50 reqs/min (batched), and average monthly token cost <= $2.5k for pilot. 

Meeting snippets / call notes (shorthand):
- PM: 'We need predictable bill + option to pin model versions.'
- SE: asked about KV cache persistence across sessions; want prefix caching and token reuse.
- Legal: must confirm EU data residency for some customers; also SOC2 is a must.
- Finance: target ARR conversion if pilot succeeds = $75-200k; wants clear Dedicated ROI modeling.

POC details: Hosted API implemented first because they want to iterate prompts. Collecting token-level cost traces and latency histograms. SE will run batching and cache experiment in week 2 of POC. Quantization is acceptable if it doesn't degrade NLU quality beyond 2% relative F1 on internal eval set.

Workshop plan: 90-min cost optimization session booked 2026-02-27 with product, infra, finance. Agenda: current token breakdown, batching strategies per endpoint, prefix/KV caching candidates, recommended quantization profiles, expected cost delta estimates, tradeoffs table. Action: deliver workbook + model/quant profiles + Dedicated pricing scenarios after workshop.

Sticking points: legal/residency + sample-based quality regressed slightly when applying aggressive 4-bit quant on reranker. Need Redwood to provide quant profile guidance and run a small AB test during POC.
latency_sla: p95 < 120ms for chat short-turns, p99 < 300ms optional
